summary: The construction and proof are correct. The closed triangle has exactly one integer point on y=0 and M+1 integer points on y=1; the affine function takes values 2 and 1 on these points. This gives the asserted count formula, including the equality case t=1/2, and the fixed choices t=1/2 and delta=1/4 make the comparison ratio (M+2)/9 unbounded. All positivity, integrality, full-dimensionality, and unique integer-maximum assertions hold for every integer M>=1.
